[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'archsimd Int32x4 needs amd64 or arm64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

logos run .
stdout '^vec ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/logos.txt
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/logos.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/simdguse

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"simd/archsimd"
)

func main() {
	var xs = [4]int32{1, 2, 3, 4}
	var ys = [4]int32{10, 20, 30, 40}
	v := archsimd.LoadInt32x4Array(&xs).Add(archsimd.LoadInt32x4Array(&ys))
	var out [4]int32
	v.StoreArray(&out)
	var want [4]int32
	for i := range xs {
		want[i] = xs[i] + ys[i]
	}
	if out != want {
		fmt.Println("mismatch", out, want)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("vec ok")
}
